prompt: Create one production-ready raster UI sprite for Bullets of Fury, a 16-bit pixel-art vertical arcade shooter. A wide rectangular in-game dialogue window, approximately 4:1 aspect ratio, front-on, perfectly flat and aligned with the canvas. ONE window only, no text, letters, icons, pilot portraits, logo, example messages or mockup. Rectangular charcoal gunmetal border with crisp stepped square corners, small symmetric corner rivets, layered dark steel bevels and narrow saturated cyan-blue inset trim that can be palette swapped later. Restrained cool futuristic military arcade frame, authentic hand-placed 16-bit pixel clusters, hard edges, no photographic metal, no gradients, no glow blur, no rounded capsule shapes, no top tab, no protruding decorations. Border is thin: approximately 8% of height; keep 84% of the height as an uninterrupted opaque near-black empty interior for centered readable text. The interior must be flat near-black, no grid or decorative lines. Neutral grey steel must stay neutral; cyan-blue accents exclusively on the trim. Fit entire frame inside the image with small equal outer margins. Truly transparent exterior around the window; the dark text panel itself is opaque. Aim for a 1024 by 256 wide image, or use the widest available canvas with the rectangle centered. High-quality coherent pixel art, symmetry and consistent pixel size. No checkerboard pattern baked into the output.
usage: Generated shared pilot dialogue plate; cyan trim is palette-swappable.
